title: Forge — Agent Behavior
_comment: Agent behavior: tool-call distribution, stuck-rate, model usage by tier (docs/14 §6). Built on forge.session_event.

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo_id FROM forge.session_event ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tool-call distribution (top 20)
panels._comment: forge.mcp.server distinguishes platform vs registry MCP (docs/14 §3). tool_name from the tool_call event payload.

targets.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'tool_name') AS tool, count() AS c FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'tool_call' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Stuck-rate (sessions that hit activity=stuck)
panels._comment: Stuck-rate from the activity transitions (docs/11 §3). Stuck → failed is the failure path.

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, countIf(activity = 'stuck') AS stuck, count() AS total FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'status_transition' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Model usage by tier (tokens)
panels._comment: forge.model.id distinguishes the model; tier mapping is the AI Gateway config (docs/08 §6).

targets.query: SELECT model, sum(tokens_in + tokens_out) AS tokens FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'cost_event' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY model ORDER BY tokens DESC

panels.title: Tool retry rate
panels._comment: High retry rate flags flaky tools (docs/14 §6 agent behavior).

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS t, avg(JSONExtractFloat(payload, 'retry_count')) AS avg_retries FROM forge.session_event WHERE event_type = 'tool_call' AND ts > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
